entries.english: Please enter your Cash Card number to continue.
entries.fr: Saisis ton numéro de carte bancaire.

entries.english: And you say your great-grandfather studied psychic phenomena...
entries.fr: Et ton arrière-grand-père étudiait les phénomènes psychiques...

entries.english: It seems to me that you should look around for any notes he might have kept.
entries.fr: Tu devrais chercher les notes qu'il a pu laisser.

entries.english: I wouldn't go anywhere near the place without a really good baseball bat.
entries.fr: Je n'irais pas là-bas sans une excellente batte de baseball.

entries.english: He goes to the elementary school in Merrysville, you can't miss it.
entries.fr: Il va à l'école primaire de Merrysville. Tu le trouveras.

entries.english: He's a genius, but he's also really anxious.
entries.fr: C'est un génie, mais il est très anxieux.

entries.english: Head north of Merrysville to Duncan's Factory.
entries.fr: Va au nord de Merrysville, à l'usine Duncan.

entries.english: This just in from Merrysville...
entries.fr: Flash info de Merrysville...

entries.english: A lost-and-found is being established at all the railway stations.
entries.fr: Un service des objets trouvés ouvre dans chaque gare.

entries.english: You'd be surprised at the kind of stuff people drop when they get off the train.
entries.fr: Tu serais surpris de voir ce que les gens perdent en descendant du train.

entries.english: Oh, but the train is still stuck... Hmm...
entries.fr: Mais le train est encore bloqué... Hmm...

entries.english: So, you found a hat at the Reindeer train station...
entries.fr: Tu as trouvé un chapeau à la gare de Reindeer...

entries.english: It belongs to a girl in Snowman, you should give it to her!
entries.fr: Il est à une fille de Snowman. Rapporte-le-lui!

entries.english: It might be a bit of a challenge to get to her without the train.
entries.fr: Sans train, ce sera difficile de la rejoindre.

entries.english: Since the train tracks are now clear of debris,
entries.fr: Maintenant que les voies sont dégagées,

entries.english: First of all...
entries.fr: Tout d'abord...

entries.english: An awful lot of people lose important things at train stations.
entries.fr: Beaucoup de gens perdent des objets précieux à la gare.

entries.english: Keep an eye out for something like that.
entries.fr: Ouvre l'oeil pour trouver quelque chose.

entries.english: So you just found a pretty pink hat?
entries.fr: Tu as trouvé un joli chapeau rose?

entries.english: You should probably find out who it belongs to and give it back to them!
entries.fr: Tu devrais chercher sa propriétaire et le lui rendre!

entries.english: Are there any places you haven't fully explored yet?
entries.fr: Reste-t-il des endroits que tu n'as pas explorés?

entries.english: Have you been to Spookane?
entries.fr: Tu es allé à Spookane?

entries.english: It is an eerie place... but many people are still trying to call it home.
entries.fr: C'est un lieu sinistre... mais des gens y vivent encore.

entries.english: One of the biggest buildings in town is an old mansion.
entries.fr: Un des plus grands bâtiments de la ville est un manoir.

entries.english: The owners have had to move elsewhere due to paranormal activity...
entries.fr: Les propriétaires ont fui à cause de phénomènes paranormaux...

entries.english: Have you been to the Yucca Desert?
entries.fr: Tu es allé au désert Yucca?

entries.english: The bridge is out, but there should be a way through to the north.
entries.fr: Le pont est coupé, mais on peut passer plus au nord.

entries.english: There's plenty to explore over there!
entries.fr: Il y a beaucoup à découvrir là-bas!

entries.english: There's a man offering airplane rides, too!
entries.fr: Un homme propose aussi des tours en avion!

entries.english: You have to buy tickets, though, so make sure to bring cash.
entries.fr: Il faut acheter un billet, alors prends de l'argent.

entries.english: Have you been to Youngtown?
entries.fr: Tu es allé à Youngtown?

entries.english: The word on the wind is that something odd happened there...
entries.fr: On raconte qu'il s'y est passé quelque chose d'étrange...

entries.english: You should investigate.
entries.fr: Tu devrais enquêter.

entries.english: Have you been east of Youngtown?
entries.fr: Tu es allé à l'est de Youngtown?

entries.english: It's a hustling, bustling city with lots of fun things to do.
entries.fr: C'est une ville animée où l'on ne s'ennuie jamais.

entries.english: ...Fun things to do in Ellay...
entries.fr: ...Des loisirs à Ellay...

entries.english: If you walk northwest of Downtown Ellay, you'll find a lookout tower.
entries.fr: Au nord-ouest du centre d'Ellay se trouve une tour.

entries.english: It's a really nice place to visit. The view is spectacular.
entries.fr: C'est un bel endroit. La vue est magnifique.

entries.english: You'll have to pay the cover charge, of course.
entries.fr: Il faut bien sûr payer l'entrée.

entries.english: But having community resources like this is so important, so it's worth it!
entries.fr: Mais ce lieu compte pour la ville, alors ça vaut le prix!

entries.english: Or well, it's more than a music venue, really.
entries.fr: En fait, c'est plus qu'une salle de concert.

entries.english: Next week, there's a showing of Creature from the Vegetable Soup!
entries.fr: La semaine prochaine: La Créature de la soupe aux légumes!

entries.english: Oh, you're too focused on saving the world for that?
entries.fr: Ah, tu es trop occupé à sauver le monde?

entries.english: You might just meet a new friend there.
entries.fr: Tu pourrais y rencontrer un nouvel ami.

entries.english: I imagine the best thing to do at this point is to investigate Mt. Itoi to the east.
entries.fr: Je crois qu'il faut maintenant explorer le mont Itoi, à l'est.

entries.english: I'm hearing that you can almost feel the tension in the air.
entries.fr: On dit que la tension est presque palpable.

entries.english: Have you been to Spookane?
entries.fr: Tu es allé à Spookane?

entries.english: You should investigate. Who knows what you might find?
entries.fr: Va voir. Qui sait ce que tu pourrais trouver?

entries.english: Have you fully explored the Yucca Desert?
entries.fr: As-tu exploré tout le désert Yucca?

entries.english: Maybe that nerdy friend of yours could fix it up.
entries.fr: Ton ami le génie pourrait peut-être le réparer.

entries.english: Oh, he's not with you at the moment? Hmm...
entries.fr: Ah, il n'est pas avec toi? Hmm...

entries.english: Well, you should check it out anyway.
entries.fr: Va voir quand même.

entries.english: Have you fully explored Mt. Itoi?
entries.fr: As-tu exploré tout le mont Itoi?

entries.english: But something tells me you might have missed something there.
entries.fr: Mais je crois que tu as raté quelque chose là-bas.

entries.english: With any luck, it's something right at the top...
entries.fr: Avec un peu de chance, c'est tout en haut...

entries.english: I've heard rumors of a legendary bard who might be able to help you.
entries.fr: J'ai entendu parler d'un barde légendaire qui pourrait t'aider.

entries.english: Do you know anywhere like that?
entries.fr: Tu connais un tel endroit?

entries.english: With a pretty song like that, you've got a performance lined up, haven't you?
entries.fr: Avec une si jolie chanson, tu vas donner un concert?

entries.english: Some kings or queens would give anything to hear a song that beautiful...
entries.fr: Des rois et reines donneraient tout pour cette belle chanson...

entries.english: Even after all you've been through, Mt. Itoi is still a nightmare.
entries.fr: Malgré tes efforts, le mont Itoi reste un cauchemar.

entries.english: Never lose hope, okay?
entries.fr: Ne perds pas espoir!

entries.english: We're sorry,
entries.fr: Désolés,

entries.english: Please contact us again!
entries.fr: Rappelle-nous bientôt!

entries.english: That's just fine, but...
entries.fr: D'accord, mais...

entries.english: Excuse me,
entries.fr: Pardon,

entries.english: Hello there...
entries.fr: Bonjour...

entries.english: I am the boy's dad.
entries.fr: Je suis son père.

entries.english: I thought it would be nice to at least know your name.
entries.fr: J'aimerais au moins connaître ton nom.

entries.english: I have some very important things to talk about.
entries.fr: J'ai des choses très importantes à te dire.

entries.english: Hello!  This is Escargo Express.
entries.fr: Bonjour! Ici Escargo Express.

entries.english: We've started part-time jobs with Escargo Express.
entries.fr: On travaille à temps partiel chez Escargo Express.

entries.english: She's organizing packages and I'm answering the phone.
entries.fr: Elle trie les colis et je réponds au téléphone.

entries.english: Anyways! Can we help you?
entries.fr: Bref! On peut t'aider?

entries.english: Oh hey big brother!
entries.fr: Salut, grand frère!

entries.english: What? No! I'm Mimmie, don't get me confused with Minnie!
entries.fr: Quoi? Non! Je suis Mimmie, pas Minnie!

entries.english: I hope your trip is going well! Have you had any new adventures?
entries.fr: J'espère que ton voyage se passe bien! Du nouveau?

entries.english: Hello! This is Escargo Express.
entries.fr: Bonjour! Ici Escargo Express.

entries.english: Mimmie doesn't work here any more.  Yeah, she used to work here, part-time.
entries.fr: Mimmie ne travaille plus ici. Avant, elle était à mi-temps.

entries.english: I've heard about the great work you're doing.
entries.fr: On m'a parlé de tes exploits.

entries.english: My wife is out on maternity leave, so I'm taking care of my other kid.
entries.fr: Ma femme est en congé maternité, je garde notre autre enfant.

entries.english: I decided to take some time off from the delivery business.
entries.fr: J'ai pris un peu de repos loin des livraisons.

entries.english: It's right next to the fridge!  Put it into the microwave...  ...that's it.
entries.fr: C'est près du frigo! Mets-le au micro-ondes... Voilà.

entries.english: ...Sorry about that.
entries.fr: ...Désolé pour ça.

entries.english: I really would like to hear some of your stories.
entries.fr: J'aimerais vraiment écouter tes aventures.

entries.english: *Crash!* Hey, hey!  Now look what you've done!
entries.fr: *Boum!* Hé! Regarde ce que tu as fait!

entries.english: I just (hee, ha, he, ha) couldn't find your location...
entries.fr: Je n'ai (hi, ha, hi, ha) pas trouvé ta position...

entries.english: ...You must be somewhere really strange.  (hee, ha, he, ha)
entries.fr: ...Tu dois être dans un lieu très étrange. (hi, ha, hi, ha)

entries.english: I've decided, honestly, that... I should give up.
entries.fr: Franchement, j'ai décidé... d'abandonner.

entries.english: I'm outta here.  (hee, ha, he, ha)
entries.fr: Je m'en vais. (hi, ha, hi, ha)

entries.english: My little man, out there, saving the world.
entries.fr: Mon petit garçon, parti sauver le monde.

entries.english: When did you get to be so brave?
entries.fr: Quand es-tu devenu si courageux?

entries.english: I remember when you were still afraid to go to the bathroom alone at night...
entries.fr: Je me souviens quand tu avais peur d'aller seul aux toilettes la nuit...

entries.english: What? Oh sorry, I wasn't trying to embarrass you, sweetie.
entries.fr: Quoi? Pardon, je ne voulais pas te gêner, mon chéri.

entries.english: Hi honey!
entries.fr: Coucou!

entries.english: I'm still picking up after the house tried to shake itself apart...
entries.fr: Je range encore après les secousses de la maison...

entries.english: Oh, by the way!  The twins got part-time jobs working for Escargo Express.
entries.fr: Au fait! Les jumelles travaillent à mi-temps chez Escargo Express.

entries.english: I'll let them tell you about it.
entries.fr: Je les laisse t'en parler.

entries.english: Do you have a cold?
entries.fr: Tu es enrhumé?

entries.english: Listen, I know there are ghosts to fight and bigfoots to catch or whatever...
entries.fr: Je sais, il y a des fantômes à chasser et des yétis à attraper...

entries.english: Honey, is your asthma flaring up again?
entries.fr: Mon chéri, ton asthme revient?

entries.english: If you didn't, go to the drugstore.  Do you have enough money?
entries.fr: Sinon, va à la pharmacie. Tu as assez d'argent?

entries.english: Am I worrying too much?
entries.fr: Je m'inquiète trop?

entries.english: I heard that you have a new friend traveling with you now.
entries.fr: On m'a dit que tu voyages avec une nouvelle amie.

entries.english: Okay, Okay... sorry, I couldn't resist asking.
entries.fr: D'accord, pardon... je n'ai pas pu résister.

entries.english: The next time you're nearby, you should invite all of your new friends over for dinner.
entries.fr: Quand tu repasseras, invite tous tes nouveaux amis à dîner.

entries.english: So, how's the adventure going?
entries.fr: Alors, comment va l'aventure?

entries.english: Maybe I shouldn't have asked. Now I'm going to worry!
entries.fr: Je n'aurais pas dû demander. Je vais m'inquiéter!

entries.english: You know how moms are...
entries.fr: Tu connais les mamans...

entries.english: I'm in the middle of doing the laundry, so I'd better go!
entries.fr: Je fais la lessive, alors je dois te laisser!

entries.english: Why was I thinking about you?
entries.fr: Pourquoi je pensais à toi?

entries.english: I was clipping coupons and I found a two-for-one on your favorite snacks!
entries.fr: Je découpais des coupons et j'ai trouvé une promo sur tes friandises!

entries.english: They'll be here when you get home.
entries.fr: Elles t'attendent à la maison.

entries.english: Listen, I have to run.  The girls are helping me put away groceries.
entries.fr: Je file. Les filles m'aident à ranger les courses.

entries.english: I knew if I said your name three times, I'd get a call from you!
entries.fr: Je savais qu'en disant ton nom trois fois, tu appellerais!

entries.english: Okay, yes.  I'm just teasing...
entries.fr: Oui, je plaisante...

entries.english: Having a weird mom builds character, I'll have you know!
entries.fr: Avoir une maman bizarre, ça forge le caractère!

entries.english: Everyone here is doing well.
entries.fr: Tout le monde va bien ici.

entries.english: Well, I better go... I think brunch just caught fire.
entries.fr: Bon, je dois filer... Le brunch a pris feu.

entries.english: Call again!
entries.fr: Rappelle!
